mentions.name: The disappearing code forge
mentions.description: A constellation of git collaboration services, all self-hostable, built with a focus on minimalism and Unix philosophy. Includes a patch-based collaboration service and a CI/CD solution.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm iterating on a constellation of git collab services that I'm calling "the disappearing code forge." All self hostable with a focus on minimalism and Unix philosophy.
mentions.author: qudat
